latest_release.name: beta-0.2.1
latest_release.body:
## What's new

A stability-focused release: runtime teardown and threading fixes, rendering fixes on iOS and Android, faster hot paths, and Xcode 27 support.

### Runtime stability
- Hardened runtime teardown at app termination: JS dispatch is refused once the JS queue is torn down, visibility observers are no longer flushed into a destroyed context, and the native context stays retained across in-flight Java calls.
- Deadline-bounded synchronous JS calls now fail fast while the JS thread is stalled instead of blocking the caller.
- Fixed a race in the initial auto-render publication on Android.
- Promises handed to native code are no longer reported as unhandled.
- QuickJS `dumpMemoryStatistics` is now O(1), removing a source of JS-thread stalls.
- iOS arm64e: ObjC block invoke pointers are authenticated with the block ABI.
- Android: avoid a legacy reflection crash in function lookup.
- Null image-download cancellation handles are handled safely.

### Rendering and views
- iOS views with layout callbacks are now recyclable.
- iOS text views redraw on resize instead of stretching a stale bitmap.
- Dashed and dotted iOS borders animate with the corner radius.
- Image views reuse images that JS already preloaded; Android skips drawing recycled bitmaps.
- Pickers re-measure when their value changes.
- Attributed-text tap recognizers are removed when a label switches to plain text.
- Android: selectable text inputs restore their movement method when they become editable.
- New iOS `DateFormatting` module so Valdi-formatted times honor the system 24-Hour Time setting.

### Performance
- Removed per-render allocations and global-lock interning from hot paths.
- Module loading skips an always-missing source map lookup.
- View pool hits, misses, and drops are reported per module.
- Added headless microbenchmarks for layout, render, and runtime init.

### Compiler and code generation
- Generated C++ int enums now carry their TypeScript values.
- Vue template attributes are emitted in source order.

### Build and tooling
- Xcode 27 / macOS 27 builds are supported.
- Maven dependencies are pinned with lock files, avoiding Maven Central rate-limit (429) failures during builds.
- `com_android_dex` is fetched from the AOSP GitHub mirror.
- The Linux Swift toolchain is no longer fetched on macOS.
- Web: build-system groundwork for the web target (no renderer changes yet).

### Docs and project
- New `VERSIONING.md` and an RFC process; refreshed `ROADMAP.md`.
- Contribution rules, governance, and support docs; PR expectations in `CONTRIBUTING.md`; YAML issue forms.
- `SECURITY.md` scope clarified; clean MIT `LICENSE`.
- Setup docs and codelab fixes, including an Xcode 26.5/27 support note.

### Valdi_Widgets
- `CoreTextField` can now shrink inside fixed-width parents (Snapchat/Valdi_Widgets#23).
- The release branch pins `rules_android` 0.6.5 to match Valdi.

## Community contributions

Thank you to everyone who contributed to this release:

- @bjdodson-openai: portable ClientSQL runtime and debugger (#181)
- @tx3stn: `ArrayBuffer` typing fix for TypeScript 5.7+ (#186)
- @tx3stn: `createDirectorySync` no longer reports success without creating the directory (#187)
- @kwy404: `spawnCliCommand` no longer re-prints accumulated output (#190)

## Upgrading

- Install or update the CLI: `npm i -g @snap/valdi@1.2.1`. New projects from `valdi bootstrap` pin Valdi and Valdi_Widgets to `beta-0.2.1`.
- Existing projects: set `VALDI_TAG = "beta-0.2.1"` in `MODULE.bazel` (update the integrity hash), and point the registry in `.bazelrc` at `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Snapchat/Valdi/beta-0.2.1/registry`.
- Valdi_Widgets users: use the `beta-0.2.1` tag (from the `release/beta-0.2.1` branch).
- If you build with Xcode 27, upgrade: beta-0.2.0 (the CLI 1.2.0 default) does not build there.
- CLI 1.2.1 fixes `valdi install ios --simulator`, which was inverted and built for a device.

## Known issues

- `//valdi:valdi_ios_objc_test` can abort intermittentl
